defs.def: to make pictures, or a picture of sth, with a pencil, pen or chalk (but not paint) （用铅笔、钢笔或粉笔）画，描绘，描画

ex.s: When I was a little girl, I liked drawing, freely and joyously making marks on the walls at home.
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我喜欢画画，自由而快乐地在家里墙上涂画。

ex.s: Writing seemed to be another form of drawing.
ex.t: 写字似乎是另一种形式的绘画。

ex.s: I let my line drawings turn into cartoons I send to friends.
ex.t: 我让我的线条画变成漫画发给朋友们。

ex.s: From Snoopy to Spider-Man and bears to butterflies, there isn't much he hasn't drawn.
ex.t: 从史努比到蜘蛛侠，从熊到蝴蝶，没什么他没画过的。

ex.s: To give an instruction of drawing a budget Line.
ex.t: 你能看的电影的最大数量是10部。

ex.s: He was impressed with Benjamin’s drawings.
ex.t: 他对本杰明的画作印象深刻。

ex.s: So we still need to prepare food and drinks I'll make a checklist Preparation choose presents for Grandma draw up the guest list on Wednesday make invitations prepare food and drinks on Sunday morning Who's responsible?
ex.t: 所以我们还需要准备食物和饮料。我来列个清单：准备——给奶奶选礼物；星期三拟好客人名单；做邀请函；准备食物和饮料；星期天早上——谁负责？

ex.s: When someone is giving you directions, try to mark your destinations and draw the routes to them on the map.
ex.t: 当有人给你指路时，试着在地图上标出你的目的地并画出到达它们的路线。

ex.s: If you now draw a line from the highest, leftmost dot to the lowest, rightmost dot you'll have created a budget line.
ex.t: 如果你现在从最高、最左边的点到最低、最右边的点画一条线，你就画出了一条预算线。

ex.s: Draw their outlines.
ex.t: 画出它们的轮廓。

ex.s: While waiting at the gate, Han Gan used a stick to draw pictures in the dirt and was seen by the poet himself.
ex.t: 在门口等待时，韩干用一根棍子在地上画画，被诗人本人看到了。

ex.s: Parry quickly graduated from his early hearts and sharks, and started to surprise families with drawings that captured young patients’ personalities.
ex.t: 帕里很快不再画最初的心形和鲨鱼，而是开始用捕捉小患者个性的画作给各个家庭带来惊喜。

ex.s: Reform should draw from the wellspring of past wisdom.
ex.t: 改革应从过往智慧的源泉中汲取养分。

ex.s: We started to meet regularly to draw up our plans.
ex.t: 我们开始定期见面制定计划。

ex.s: Even though this technique won't work for everyone, it helps many people get a good store of ideas to draw on.
ex.t: 虽然这种技巧不一定对每个人都有效，但它帮助许多人积累了大量可供借鉴的想法。

defs.def: to move sth/sb by pulling it or them gently 拖（动）；拉（动）；牵引

ex.s: From there he drew me into a(n)  26 .
ex.t: 从那里，他把我引入了（26）。

ex.s: Class activities will vary from day to day, but students must be ready to complete short in-class writings or tests drawn directly from assigned readings or notes from the previous class' lecture/discussion, so it is important to take careful notes during class.
ex.t: 课堂活动每天不同，但学生必须准备好完成直接取自指定阅读或上节课讲座/讨论笔记的简短课堂写作或测试，所以课堂上认真记笔记很重要。

ex.s: Already, a number of films, including "Water for Elephants," "The Hangover Part Ⅱ" and "Zookeeper," have drawn the anger of activists who say the creatures acting in them haven’t been treated properly.
ex.t: 已经有不少影片，包括《大象的眼泪》《宿醉2》和《动物园看守》，引来了活动人士的愤怒，他们说片中动物的待遇不当。

defs.def: to pull a vehicle such as a carriage 马匹等
to open or close curtains, etc. 拉（窗帘、帘子）

ex.s: Days later when the curtain was drawn, I saw this  31  old man for the first time.
ex.t: 几天后当帘子拉开时，我第一次看到了这位31 老人。

defs.def: to move in the direction mentioned （向某个方向）移动，行进
to take out a weapon, such as a gun or a sword, in order to attack sb 拔出；抽出；掏出
to attract or interest sb 吸引；招引；使感兴趣

ex.s: Which program will you join if you're interested in drawing pictures?
ex.t: 如果你对画画感兴趣，你会参加哪个项目？

ex.s: He is more interested in knitting than drawing.
ex.t: 他对编织比绘画更感兴趣。

ex.s: The Socrates Express is a fun, sharp book that draws readers in with its apparent simplicity and gradually pulls them in deeper thoughts on desire, loneliness, and aging.
ex.t: 《苏格拉底快线》是一本有趣而犀利的书，以其表面的简单吸引读者，逐渐将他们带入对欲望、孤独和衰老的更深思考。

ex.s: Discover why artists and photographers continue to be drawn to this special place.
ex.t: 探索为什么艺术家和摄影师一直被这个特别的地方所吸引。

ex.s: Why are young birds drawn to the road surface？
ex.t: 为什么幼鸟会被吸引到路面上？

ex.s: Why are young birds drawn to the road surface？
ex.t: 为什么幼鸟会被吸引到路面上？

ex.s: This is when a pop star draws far more attention than, say, gradual biodiversity decline.
ex.t: 这就是当一位流行明星比，比如说，渐进的生物多样性衰退吸引更多关注时的情况。

ex.s: But that night I felt drawn to the violin shop the moment I came across it.
ex.t: 但那天晚上，我一偶然看到那家小提琴店，就感到被它吸引。

defs.def: to produce a reaction or response 产生，引起，激起（反应或回应）

ex.s: Comparing yourself with someone who is outperforming you could result in feelings of envy if you focus on the things they have and you don’t, or it can be energizing and inspiring if you use these comparisons as a source of motivation, for example, “If they can achieve that, so can I.” Comparing yourself with someone who is doing worse than you could result in fear and worry if you think about how you could fall into similar circumstances, or it can draw out feelings of gratitude and appreciation if you use that comparison to broaden your views — for example, “Wow, things could be much worse; I’m doing great.”
ex.t: 把自己和表现优于你的人比较，如果你盯着他们有而你没有的东西，可能产生嫉妒；但如果你把这些比较当作动力来源，比如“他们能做到，我也能”，它就会令人振奋和鼓舞。把自己和不如你的人比较，如果你想到自己也可能陷入类似境地，可能产生恐惧和担忧；但如果你用这种比较拓宽视角，比如“哇，情况可能更糟，我已经很不错了”，它就会引发感恩和知足。

ex.s: Drawing public attention to plastic waste.
ex.t: 引起公众对塑料垃圾的关注。

ex.s: The group interaction and its effect drew the researchers' attention.
ex.t: 一支优秀的球队可能需要平衡——不仅要有A级球员，还要有一些乐于奉献的B级球员。

ex.s: Many fish perform suction feeding that requires specialised body parts to quickly generate air pressure that can draw nearby food into their mouths.
ex.t: 许多鱼类进行吸食式进食，这需要特殊的身体部位快速产生气压，将附近的食物吸入嘴里。

defs.def: to make sb say more about sth 使说出；使吐露
to have a particular idea after you have studied sth or thought about it 获取；得出；推断出

ex.s: （4）What conclusion can be drawn from the examples in Paragraph 4？
ex.t: （4）从第4段的例子中可以得出什么结论？

ex.s: We can draw strength and inspiration from these stories and they’re often closer than you think.
ex.t: 我们可以从这些故事中汲取力量和灵感，而它们往往比你想象的更近。

ex.s: An evolutionary inference can then be drawn. ＂As a parent, do you invest in quality children, or do you invest in children that are in need?＂ Kleindorfer asks. ＂Our results suggest that they might be going for quality.＂
ex.t: 由此可以做出一个进化上的推断。“作为父母，你是投资在优质的孩子身上，还是投资在需要帮助的孩子身上？”克莱因多弗问道。“我们的结果表明，它们可能是在追求质量。”

ex.s: The benefits of print reading particularly shine through when experimenters move from posing simple tasks — like identifying the main idea in a reading passage — to ones that require mental abstraction — such as drawing inferences from a text.
ex.t: 当实验者从简单任务——比如找出一段阅读材料的主旨——转向需要心智抽象的任务——比如从文本中做推断——时，纸质阅读的优势尤为明显。

defs.def: to express a comparison or a contrast 进行，作（比较或对比）

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分为两组：“美”组被要求主动思考并为所看到的每件物品的美打分，而对照组只是将物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

ex.s: draw a comparison
ex.t: 作比较

ex.s: In doing so, I’ll draw on an experiment I ran in 2018 in which over 1,600 people agreed to perform a digital declutter.
ex.t: 在这样做的过程中，我将援引我在2018年进行的一项实验，其中有1600多人同意进行数字清理。

ex.s: A GI could, its advocates say, work for us around the clock, and drawing on all available data, could suggest solutions to many problems.
ex.t: 其支持者说，AGI可以日夜不停地为我们工作，并借助一切可用数据，为许多问题提出解决方案。

defs.def: to decide sth by picking cards, tickets or numbers by chance 抽（签、牌）；抓（阄）
to finish a game without either team winning 以平局结束；不分胜负
to take money or payments from a bank account or post office 提取；领取；支取
to take or pull liquid or gas from somewhere 抽出；吸出
to breathe in smoke or air 抽（烟）；吸（气）
to stop doing sth and rest 停下来歇口气

ex.s: The problem may be that, in our offices, we can't stop ourselves from getting drawn into others’ conversations while we’re trying to focus.
ex.t: 问题可能在于，在我们的办公室里，当我们试图专注时，我们无法阻止自己被卷入别人的对话。

defs.def: to live; to be alive 生存；活着

the act of choosing sth, for example the winner of a prize or the teams who play each other in a competition, usually by taking pieces of paper, etc. out of a container without being able to see what is written on them 抽彩；抽奖；抽签
a game in which both teams or players finish with the same number of points 平局；和局；不分胜负
a competition in which the winners are chosen in a draw 由抽签决定赢家的竞赛
a sports match for which the teams or players are chosen in a draw 由抽签决定对手的比赛
a set of matches for which the teams or players are chosen in a draw 由抽签决定对手的系列比赛
a person, a thing or an event that attracts a lot of people 有吸引力的人（或事物）

ex.s: For Parry, the reward is knowing he hopefully made a difference in a child's life, and except for his drawings on bandages, "they can go on and live their lives and never know I was in it,” he said.
ex.t: 对帕里来说，回报在于知道自己或许改变了一个孩子的人生，而且除了他在绷带上的画，他说“他们可以继续生活，永远不知道我曾经在其中”。

ex.s: Apart from the thrill of those first heart-stopping dives, which, ironically, saved me from going under, what has drawn me is this community of generous, open-hearted souls.
ex.t: 除了那些最初令人心跳加速的跳水带来的刺激——讽刺的是，正是这些跳水救了我免于沉沦——真正吸引我的是这个由慷慨、心胸开阔的人们组成的社区。

defs.def: an act of breathing in the smoke from a cigarette 吸烟
to be quick to understand or react in a new situation 领悟敏捷；反应迅速
to be quick at pulling out a gun in order to shoot it 拔枪迅速
